howMemorisation.question: How does memorisation work?

howAiFeedback.question: How does feedback work?
howAiFeedback.answer: After you practise, Mutqin highlights words that may be weak or missed, so you know what to repeat next.

whatIsPro.question: What is Pro?
whatIsPro.answer: Pro includes recitation review, memorisation checks, fuller analytics, unlimited saved sessions, and planning tools.

howRevision.question: How does revision work?
howRevision.answer: Mutqin tracks weak ayahs, recent practice, and due reviews so you can revisit what is most likely to slip.

tajweed.legendIntro: Use this legend while you listen and repeat. It is a guide, not a replacement for a teacher.

gray.label: Silent / connection marks
gray.description: Hamzat al-wasl and silent letters that are not pronounced.

green.label: Ghunnah / Idgham with ghunnah
green.description: Nasalisation and joining with a nasal sound.

purple.label: Ikhfa / Idgham without ghunnah
purple.description: Hidden noon sound and non-nasal joining.

orange.label: Qalqalah
orange.description: Echoing stop on ق ط ب ج د.

srs.title: Review scheduling
srs.description: Return to memorised ayahs before they begin to fade. Verses that need more care appear sooner.
srs.bestFor: Keeping earlier memorisation strong over time.

techniques.title: Guided practice
techniques.description: Listen, follow and repeat at a comfortable pace. Choose the method that helps you stay steady.
techniques.bestFor: Students building a calm daily rhythm.

repetition.label: Repetition
repetition.text: Repeat the same verse a few times before moving on.

linking.label: Linking
linking.text: Connect each verse to the next to improve flow.

cumulative.label: Cumulative
cumulative.text: Add new verses while gently revising earlier ones.

layouts.title: Reading layouts
layouts.description: Switch between stacked cards and a Mushaf-style page depending on what feels easiest to follow.
layouts.bestFor: Choosing a reading view that stays comfortable.

stacked.label: Stacked layout
stacked.text: Shows each ayah clearly, one after another — helpful on smaller screens.

mushaf.label: Mushaf layout
mushaf.text: Shows ayahs in a familiar page-inspired style.

aiRecitation.title: Recitation check
aiRecitation.description: Recite from memory and let Mutqin follow your progress. See which words may need a little more attention.
aiRecitation.bestFor: Students who want gentle feedback after practising aloud.

talqinMode.title: Talqin mode
talqinMode.description: Listen, pause, repeat, and extend at a steady pace so you can focus on the ayahs themselves.
talqinMode.bestFor: Students building retention through guided listening and repetition.
talqinMode.workflowIntro: After you begin, Mutqin keeps a steady listen–repeat rhythm so you can focus on the ayahs:
talqinMode.workflowListenText: Hear the ayah clearly, then prepare to repeat.
talqinMode.workflowPauseText: Playback pauses so you can recite what you just heard.
talqinMode.workflowExtendText: Join ayahs gradually so the passage stays connected.

manualAssessment.title: Self assessment
manualAssessment.description: After a session, note how confident you felt so the next step can stay useful.
